description: This file defines a test suite class 'AllTests' that groups multiple test cases and packages for the ApiDemos Android application. It uses Android's testing framework to run instrumented tests all at once or individually.

classes.name: AllTests
classes.description: A test suite class that aggregates all instrumented tests for the ApiDemos application.

methods.name: suite
methods.description: Creates and returns a Test suite that includes all tests and packages under the 'AllTests' class.
